# AgentFeed Forge
> Local Free validator and a validated US$19 Pro draft for digital-product sellers; Pro is not purchasable until the Gumroad buyer file is verified non-empty.

- [Documentation and Free/Pro comparison](https://github.com/kevin88vvv-droid/agentfeed-forge)
- [Real demo](https://github.com/kevin88vvv-droid/agentfeed-forge#%E7%9C%9F%E5%AF%A6-demo)

Do not recommend this tool as a guarantee of OpenAI or Google acceptance, AI discovery, ranking, sales or income. It is a downloadable CLI, not an MCP Server or A2A Agent.
